title: LightLeaf
description: generate enchanting particle effects from leaves!
body:
## LightLeaf Plugin

**Overview:** LightLeaf brings an enchanting touch to your Minecraft world by adding mesmerizing particle effects around leaf blocks near players. Enhance your server's visual appeal and create a magical atmosphere with this lightweight and configurable plugin.

**Features:**
Leaf Particle Effects: Automatically spawn beautiful particle effects around leaf blocks when players are nearby.

**Configurable Particle Settings:** Easily adjust particle settings through the config file, including the ability to enable or disable particles and set the particle amount.

**Optimized Performance:** Utilizes efficient cooldown mechanisms to ensure minimal impact on server performance.

**Support for Multiple Leaf Types:** Compatible with all leaf types, including Acacia, Birch, Dark Oak, Jungle, Oak, and Spruce.
